name: The Price
description: You notice two strange individuals in Port Ormos...

steps.description: Talk to Paimon after getting the mysterious item
Go back and check on Alexandra

dialogs.content: ...Did you close that deal?
The old cargo ship has just been unloaded. Don't worry.
The ship didn't leak, right? And about <color=#00E1FFFF>the cargo...</color> All hidden?
Yes, all hidden somewhere safe and secret.
But... what about the old stuff that have been replaced?
Just throw them away. With the new cargo in hand, the old stuff is of no use.
I—Is that okay?
Ooh! The box is open! It's surprisingly easy.
Let me see...
Umm, anyway... Let's see what it has first.
Looks like... there're only some worn clothes and a stack of letters.
It says...
"To the south of Devantaka Mountain, the old ship leaves port."
What does that mean? How can there be a ship in the mountain?
Maybe it's some kind of code...
Well... we'll just have to figure it out.
The Fatui must be plotting something.
The box could have something to do with those two Fatui...
The south of Devantaka Mountain... That's a huge area.
The view is good here. Let's wait and see if there's anyone coming.
You wait here with Paimon...
Look... Somebody's coming this way!
Why are you so late? Did you run into any trouble?
...Sorry, someone must have opened the box. I'm afraid our plan...
Tsk, did we get caught? But... it's not like the higher-ups have sent anyone here lately...
Maybe... Maybe it was Nika? Those kids have been badgering me to take them out to play...
*sigh*... That's why I told you not to get too close to those folks, unless necessary.
But their parents are always away from home, I just...
Forget it. Either way, we're leaving here today.
Leaving? Do they mean... leaving Sumeru?
We don't have any helpers. Can the plan... work? I mean, what if the higher-ups found out about us...
Stop worrying... Haven't you had enough yet?
Living in fear, never to be trusted for a single second...
Today is our last chance to get away from the Fatui!
I—I know, but...
These two... want to leave the Fatui?
I'll go have a look.
Okay. But be careful. They are the Fatui after all!
Hehe, someone has shown up after all.
You found me?
You've been eavesdropping for a while without moving.
As the wind blew just now, the bush you were hiding in swayed differently from the one next to it.
Y—You Fatui really are something...
#{M#Blond}{F#Blonde} hair... and a strange Seelie. You must be the "Traveler" mentioned in the report.
That's right.
Since you're here, I assume you have checked the stuff in the box.
I'm surprised that Alexandra's trick actually worked.
What do you want?
As you heard, Alexandra and I want to get away from the Fatui.
Stop looking at me like that. For your information, we're neither higher-ups in power nor front-line soldiers.
We are at best some pawns left in a random place waiting to be deployed.
There are plenty of people like us, but... most of them won't get any orders all their lives.
Being a Fatuus, one could only spend the rest of their life in the distrust from others.
We don't want to end up like that. Instead of wasting life here, we'd rather take the risk and free ourselves from the Fatui.
But getting away is far from easy. If we get caught, there will be... serious consequences.
So we thought up a plan to fake death in an attempt to escape.
But our "death" must be proved by someone who is convincing.
Traveler, you are such a notorious figure for the Fatui, and... Hehe, you've always been at odds with the Fatui.
You are the ideal witness to the death of two Fatui.
What made you so sure that I would come here?
I wasn't sure whether you would come, but I would wait until you come.
Patience is one of the few strengths I have.
Traveler, now that we've told you the whole story, it's your choice if you want to help.
If your answer is yes, we'll give you a handsome amount of rewards in return.
And don't worry, the money is earned by doing serious work. I can assure you!
I... I cooked dinner for those kids, sewed clothes, told stories, and took them out...
And Przheva helped others with hunting and handling prey...
If we manage to leave the Fatui, we will make a living out of these skills! And...
Enough, Alexandra! That's too much information!
Oh... right! Okay...
Anyway, it's all up to you, Traveler.
I'll help.
Thank you, Traveler. You will get rich rewards.
Then it's a deal. Now let's go separate ways and get ready.
Alexandra, you go take care of that.
And Traveler, please follow me.
Aren't you afraid I'd back out?
Then we'll fight as hard as we can, and in the end... die at your hands.
It sounds much like our original plan, right?
You'd better have enough money.
Of course, it'll be a very generous amount.
What if I hadn't come here today...
Then we would go back and suspend the plan until you come.
We've been planning this for so long. It wouldn't hurt to wait a bit longer.
So you said all those things just for me to hear?
Did you set this trap for me?
Relax. We wouldn't have had time for that.
This is the place, Traveler. Listen, it's a simple plan.
We are two... ahem, evil Fatui coming over to this forest for some evildoing.
And you, out of indignation or righteousness, try to stop us.
Just as Alexandra and I are about to run, a group of monsters appears and strikes us down.
Being outnumbered by the monsters, you have no choice but to pull back. When you are back with helpers, Alexandra and I are already gone.
That's the plan. What do you think?
Well crafted, I have to say.
For the story to make sense and our failure to seem more natural, I've put a lot of thought into it.
But why hasn't Alexandra returned by now? Just setting up some lures for monsters doesn't take that long.
Alexandra! Alexandra! *sob*...
Wait, Paimon heard someone over there!
Shoot! Alexandra must be in trouble!
Hey! Wait! Where are you going!?
Let's follow!
What happened...
Just sounds like how the Fatui would end up.
Right. The pawns in the Fatui out there collecting intel normally end up like this.
We made this plan just because we don't want to be one of them.
Sorry... ahem... Przheva...
Don't talk. I'll patch you up.
*sobbing*... I'm sorry...
Why are you here?
I'm... I'm here to pick mushrooms... *sob*...
Alexandra... looks so sad these days...
So we talked about cooking something great to surprise her.
Alexandra once took us here and picked all those delicious mushrooms, and I thought I'd pick some myself.
B—But I got lost in the woods, and before I knew it, I was surrounded by so many mushrooms.
To save me, Alexandra... Alexandra... *sob*
*cough*... It's... It's okay, Nika... I'm fine...
...Looks like there's a change of the plan.
Alexandra sustained serious injuries, and other Fatui must have noticed that we left the town without permission. If I take her back now, we will only get arrested for inspection.
Then what about your plan...
Hehe... Just go along with it and see what will happen.
I happened to see a group of the Eremites heading this way on my way here.
Traveler, you send the kid off the forest to the Eremites. I will take Alexandra and leave.
Remember our plan? Looks like now we have to do it for real.
The Eremites must think that two evil Fatui are doing something evil here, and that saving Nika is just a cover-up.
If we come under attack by the monsters... well, it serves us right.
*sob*... Alexandra... I will never make any trouble again...
...Good thing this kid didn't have the mood to listen to what we just said. No need to worry about him.
But what you did was for saving the kid...
Trust me, few would believe in "the Fatui's heroic sacrifice."
"The evil Fatui eating their own bitter fruit" is much more acceptable.
Remember the place where you eavesdropped on Alexandra and me for the first time? If... we manage to get away, I will leave a letter there.
So you knew from the beginning...
With only one chance, we have to be careful.
We should save Alexandra first!
I'm fine, Traveler... Ahem... I can take it...
...But if we miss this chance to get out of the Fatui, I'd rather... ahem, *coughing*!!
Alexandra, where are you going? Please come back with us! Everyone is looking for you!
Listen, Nika... The Traveler will take you back... ahem...
I'm... gonna take a rest here. I will be back if I'm feeling any better...
B—But...
When did I ever lie to you? Ahem... Just be a good boy, will you?
*whimper*... Okay...
Traveler, please take good care of him...
I'll be right back.
Thank you, Traveler.
Leave it to me.
But you are not evil...
Then what do you do now?
I didn't know this errand could take that long... how exhausting...
Wait! Who's there!
Nika... and Traveler, what are you doing here?
Please take care of Nika!
W—We are running out of time! Please watch Nika for a while!
What? What did you mean? Wait a moment!
Someone's under attack over there!
Alexandra should be around here. Where... Where are they?
Alexandra!
Where are you!
Stop shouting! You will only attract the monsters!
Nika told me the whole story. I'm so surprised that Alexandra and Przheva are Fatui members.
I thought they were good folks when dealing with them...
Alexandra is a good person! Przheva is tough... but also a good person!
Umm, but they are Fatui! Who knows if they are just acting nice but actually with ulterior motives?
I mean, I've heard plenty of shady deals of the Fatui.
Maybe they were just scheming something and using saving Nika as a cover-up?
They...
You don't know about that. And it's not like we can find them...
One of them is wounded... so according to my experience, the monsters must have... well...
Berat! Could you keep looking? Please!!
Nika, if I wasn't here alone, I promise I would search the whole forest out.
But there's only me here. The monsters are one thing, and what if there're other Fatui here...
Ahem, anyway... Traveler, I say we go back to the city first. I'll report this to my superior and follow his order.
Berat takes Nika and leaves...
His response is just as Przheva expected...
But did they... manage to get away?
There's not much we can do now. Let's head back.
Przheva said if they managed to leave, they would leave a letter at the place where they were.
Let's go take a look if we have time.
They... are not bad...
Przheva!
There're some... worn clothes and a stack of letters.
What does the letter say?
Let Paimon see...
It says "To the south of Devantaka Mountain, the old ship leaves port."
What does that mean? How can there be a ship in the mountain?
Maybe it's the clue to some treasures.
And we don't know who left the box here.
Anyway, let's go take a look!
Maybe it leads to a treasure trove.
Stop crying, Nika. What happened?
*sob*... Alexandra...
Alexandra? What's she doing here?
Nika, tell me what happened in detail...
Ahem... Sorry, Przheva, I'm not cut out for this job...
Don't say that.
